findings.motion: SB 1174 Min Senate Third Reading By BERMAN (Assembly floor)
findings.note: The Assembly floor roll call for SB 1174 (Elections: voter identification), which bars cities and districts, including charter cities, from requiring ID to vote at a polling place or ballot drop-off, passed 57 to 16 with 6 not voting. The roll call lists members by surname only; the surname Reyes appears in the Ayes list, and the 2024 Assembly had one member of that surname. At that time she served in the Assembly; Ballotpedia shows she took her Senate seat on 2024-12-02. Archived copy of the official leginfo vote page; the live page is blocked. The bill was chaptered 2024-09-29 as Chapter 990, Statutes of 2024.
